_comment: Real identity data for --kyc auto / --kyc ovd. Copy to config/kyc_identity.json and fill in.
config/kyc_identity.json is gitignored: these are REAL numbers and must never be committed.
Every field can also be supplied as an env var instead - see the GOLD_LOAN_KYC_* names below.
--kyc auto needs : panCardNumber, dateOfBirth, aadhaarNumber, aadhaarXmlPath
--kyc ovd  needs : ovdType, ovdNumber (+ dateOfBirth when ovdType is drivingLicense)
aadhaarNumber and the person in aadhaarXmlPath MUST be the same person, otherwise
offline-aadhaar-xml rejects it with 'Aadhaar number does not match with the XML data'.
aadhaarXmlPath is the UIDAI offline e-KYC XML (the file inside the download, unzipped).
All paths may be relative to the PROJECT ROOT (e.g. assets/voter-card.jpg) or absolute;
relative ones are anchored at the repo root, so a run works from any working directory.
ovdType is one of: voterId (fully verified against a capture) or drivingLicense.
Passport and NREGA appear in CR-2 but have no captured endpoint yet, so they are not offered.
